selection_rule: Every remaining unheld Markdown record in the fixed cohorts, at all lengths; no substitutions.
findings: Markdown spans tutorials, reference notes, test excerpts, API descriptions, personal prose and six minimal project READMEs. Original language labels and document boundaries are preserved; observed roles do not by themselves admit, reject or reallocate data.

A C# teaching List<T> recursively re-enters its overloaded equality check and cannot grow from zero capacity as written. Several JavaScript test excerpts compare a value with itself or invoke a call-order predicate without asserting its result. Printed outputs and test names are not independent verification.

The complete puzzle-solver article and algorithm appendix were read as supplied text. Its C++ fragments, diagrams and author-reported search results require a complete model and independent checks before any exercise-verification claim; table rows are not new sampled records.

A historical security article deliberately uses unsafe code and disabled mitigations for teaching. Installation tutorials, framework examples and integration instructions depend on dated toolchains and external context; none were executed, modernized or treated as current setup instructions.

Author-site self-references and a third-party README require upstream attribution/notice review. Profile assets, deployment links, personal claims and missing diagrams remain unverified; no links or images were fetched.

No new or reused verified origins for this batch. All existing holds, source-use questions and original sampling factors remain intact; the two source cohorts do not support pooled eligibility or quality rankings.
boundaries: Full static assistant reading, not independent annotation or behavioral verification. No embedded commands, compilers, solvers, vulnerable examples, tests, applications, tag-manager publishing or event sending executed.

All 218 original identities, token counts, language/license metadata and sampling weights retained; all 44 family holds preserved. No substitutions, automatic repair, length filter, document splitting or role-based admission.

No new acquisition, source-use approval, eligible yield, source ranking, training admission or GPU work. Exact offline replay validates bookkeeping and recorded inputs, not independent semantic judgments.
next: Read the remaining three unheld CSS/SCSS records at their original lengths, then consolidate file roles, provenance/notice questions and finite eligible supply in the existing qualification packet before selecting data-study arms.
